Its implications include Countable Choice and Dependent Choice for the flow lemma. [[def-axiom-of-choice]], [[thm-choice-implies-dependent-implies-countable-choice]], [[thm-conditional-expectation-is-the-l2-orthogonal-projection]], [[def-ip-misfit-evidence-and-posterior-law]]

[F1] In a proper Bayesian model, $\pi$ is the joint unknown/data law and $\pi_y$ is a version of the posterior conditional law; values on a $\pi_Y$-null set are not fixed by the conditional identity. [[def-ip-misfit-evidence-and-posterior-law]], [[def-conditional-law-given-a-random-element]]

[F8] The inverse-problem potential update is the prior reweighted by
$e^{-\Phi_y}$ and normalized by its evidence when that evidence is positive

[F9] A finite continuous potential with lower envelope $0$ under a proper
prior on a separable Banach space has positive finite evidence at every datum.

thm-ip-posterior-potential-discretizatio.read_extent: Only actual relevant Facts/declared claim excerpts; no consumer proof or unrelated argument rereview.
actual_supplier_use_paragraphs: [F1] Each finite continuous potential has a continuous section; under a common integrable lower envelope on a Borel full-measure forward domain in a separable Banach space, its fixed-data evidence is positive and finite and the normalized update is a probability measure. [[def-continuous-map-top]], [[def-banach-space]], [[def-separable-space]], [[def-borel-sigma-algebra]], [[def-probability-measure]], [[thm-ip-function-space-posterior-propriety]]

[F2] For a finite potential $\Phi$, the fixed-data evidence is $Z=\int_D e^{-\Phi}\,d\mu_0$ and the posterior density relative to $\mu_0$ is $e^{-\Phi}/Z$ when $0<Z<\infty$. [[def-ip-prior-on-a-forward-domain]], [[def-ip-misfit-evidence-and-posterior-law]]

actual_supplier_use_paragraphs: [F1] A positive-definite multivariate normal has density proportional to $\exp(-\tfrac12(x-m)^T\Sigma^{-1}(x-m))$, and the fixed-data posterior normalizes the likelihood-weighted prior. [[def-multivariate-normal-law]], [[thm-nondegenerate-multivariate-normal-law-has-density]], [[def-ip-misfit-evidence-and-posterior-law]]

actual_supplier_use_paragraphs: [F2] For a fixed $y$, $Z_\Phi(y)=\int_D e^{-\Phi(u;y)}\,\mu_{0,D}(du)$ and, only for positive finite evidence, $\Pi^y(A)=Z_\Phi(y)^{-1}\int_Ae^{-\Phi(u;y)}\,\mu_{0,D}(du)$. [[def-ip-misfit-evidence-and-posterior-law]]

actual_supplier_use_paragraphs: [F12] The function-space propriety theorem assumes a Borel probability on a separable real Banach parameter space, so it does not apply to this infinite counting measure on $\mathbb N$. [[thm-ip-function-space-posterior-propriety]]

actual_supplier_use_paragraphs: [F1] The posterior at a fixed datum is the likelihood-weighted prior divided by its evidence when the evidence is positive and finite. [[def-ip-misfit-evidence-and-posterior-law]]

actual_supplier_use_paragraphs: [F5] For the displayed common lower envelope and continuity assumptions, the evidence is finite and strictly positive, and the normalized fiberwise update is a probability. [[thm-ip-function-space-posterior-propriety]]
[F14] At a fixed datum, evidence is the prior integral of the likelihood section and the normalized update is defined only at positive finite evidence. [[def-ip-misfit-evidence-and-posterior-law]]

actual_supplier_use_paragraphs: [F1] The fixed-data posterior density relative to $\mu_0$ is $e^{-\Phi(u;y)}/Z(y)$ when $0<Z(y)<\infty$. [[def-ip-misfit-evidence-and-posterior-law]]

thm-ip-hellinger-data-stability.read_extent: Only actual relevant Facts/declared claim excerpts; no consumer proof or unrelated argument rereview.
actual_supplier_use_paragraphs: [F1] A prior on a forward domain is a Borel probability $\mu_0$ on $X$ with $\mu_0(D)=1$. Product measurability as an extended-real-valued function makes each fixed-data potential section measurable; the evidence and posterior are $Z(y)=\int_D e^{-\Phi(u;y)}\,d\mu_0$ and $d\Pi^y/d\mu_0=e^{-\Phi(u;y)}/Z(y)$ when $0<Z(y)<\infty$. [[def-ip-prior-on-a-forward-domain]], [[def-probability-measure]], [[def-borel-sigma-algebra]], [[def-ip-misfit-evidence-and-posterior-law]], [[def-product-sigma-algebra-and-finite-product-sigma-algebras]], [[def-measurable-function-between-measurable-spaces]], [[def-extended-reals]], [[def-borel-sigma-algebra-on-the-extended-real-line]], [[thm-sections-of-product-measurable-functions-are-measurable]]

[F2] A continuous section on $D$ is continuous in the relative topology; for a finite continuous potential with a common integrable lower envelope, the evidence is finite and strictly positive on every asserted data fiber. [[def-continuous-map-top]], [[thm-ip-function-space-posterior-propriety]]

actual_supplier_use_paragraphs: [F1] A prior is a Borel probability with full mass on its declared domain; the fixed-data posterior is the normalized measure with density proportional to $e^{-\Phi}$ on that domain.
